create_scannet_dataset_config: create a ScannetDatasetConfig instance to access ScanNet class mappings and mean object sizes
convert_box_size_to_class: convert a 3D box size and type name to a size class and size residual using ScannetDatasetConfig.size2class
reconstruct_box_size_from_class: reconstruct a 3D box size from a size class index and residual using ScannetDatasetConfig.class2size
build_oriented_bounding_box: build an oriented bounding box (center, size, heading) from class and residual parameters using ScannetDatasetConfig.param2obb
rotate_aligned_boxes: rotate axis-aligned 3D boxes by applying a rotation matrix to centers and corner points using rotate_aligned_boxes
